items.message: Collision test asserts the remote blob is unchanged by text comparison, but `_git` returns stdout of `git show` (file content), not the blob hash — if `git show` fails silently it returns an empty string and the assertion compares two empty strings.

Absorb collision test records the local blob with `git show DEFAULT_BRANCH:records/…` against a working-tree repo; if `GitLedger.append` writes to a ref with a different name the show returns empty and the before/after comparison is vacuous for the same reason as above.
